regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours. I hope this finds you all well, especial- ly that your outlook is hopeful and brightening. Please pardon my tardiness, etc I think the following will be a decided asset to Father E's rhyme -letter. NOTE. The following rhyme-letter, "a remedy for the blues", from a missionary in the Philippines to a Rev. Brother - 12 years his senior and located in Yonkers, N. York. senior brother's health-failure in his early clacics. NOTE. The following rhime-letter, "a remedy for blues", is from a missionary in the Philippines to a senior brother brother in Yonkers, N. Y. Health-failure on part of the senior brother in his early classics had sent him home from the seminary, heavy-hearted, - a family disapointment. For twenty years working for vocations to makeup for his own failure and, on oc- casion of his serving at the first holy Mass of suether of his junior brothers he had decided; " ... to try it over again". He had joined the junior brother (now the missionary) in the seminary, and had preceded him to the holy Priesthood just one year. The letter, at once humorous and poetic as well as ascetic and thoroughly philosophic, offers food for every thinker. (a third Britger)
